title: Chefmakes' Wavedash
description: This mod ads the infamous wavedash from smash bros melee
body:
![HAYYYA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7803e6840a646843cd5f0e8729cd75ee4c08bbe.png)

This mod adds that famous wavedash we all destroyed our hands over. You preform it similarly to how you do it in melee; You just jump, and while holding any direction key, sneak. This will thrust you in that direction and downwards, making you slide a bit because of it. 

You can additionally adjust alot of the variables to your liking; From traction to making you feel like you're playing luigi, to the actual thrust's horizontal, and vertical force for a lighter or a heavier wavedash.

It's best to use this mod when you're fighting bosses or any scenarios where you need quick maneuverablity to avoid taking damage or the opposite

---
# Dependencies
you only need cloth config and mod menu
